_comment: Hierarchical MILP AllGather on rail_optimized_256gpu_dual_plane with switch copy. 256-GPU rail-optimized dual-plane fabric. Every GPU has a port into both planes, so every host transit is co-located (forward dwell 1). Hierarchical only. milp_chunking=4: one MILP chunk = 4 of a host's 8 identities for one destination-cell set, so 2 chunks per host -- between 'holder' (8, intractable here) and 'cell' (1, voids multipath across the 8 uplinks). Bundles span holder GPUs, so three GPUs of each group of four stage through the NVSwitch. switch_copy [true, false]: the network switches of the coarse level copy -- a fan-out is one Send, charged once on its uplink, and ncclize emits it as ONE multicast send threadblock (tb send="r1,r2") with one mscclflowid, plus a switch-JSON (format 2) entry listing every out port; the cell NVSwitches do not copy (multicast there needs NVLS). Pass --no-multicast to ncclize for the pre-multicast output (one unicast send per branch). SLOWEST_LINK keeps every coarse link at >= 1 chunk/epoch (occupancy 1: no multi-epoch legs). objective_type 6 (LEXICOGRAPHIC) puts makespan first; PAPER (3) ties on it. Outputs: Schedules/<prefix>_flat.json (+ _coarse/_identities/_intra side outputs). The current b4 configuration: the b4_nows input plus switch_no_drop and a 1 h cap on the switch_chain tier. switch_no_drop true: a switch must forward everything that reaches it ('==' in place of '>='), so the model holds no dead flow at a switch (12,288 extra rows, root model fingerprint 0x27b909cf against 0xf6ba0820 for b4_nows). host_relay and switch_chain are cost tiers, so each stops at its floor (0) and first runs Gurobi's no-relaxation heuristic before any root LP (automatic, BaseFormulation._set_cost_tier_stops; no input). Remote 2026-11-22 (then with since-removed fan-out cuts and per-tier Gurobi settings that changed nothing): tiers 385 / 566 / 31 / 3600 s, 4582 s in all; host_relay 0 in 24 s of the heuristic, without the 2 h root LP the tier used to spend proving its trivial bound; switch_chain 1074 -> 169 in the first 300 s of the heuristic (true optimum in [119, 124]), then a root bound of 64 and no progress until the cap. objective_tier_time_limit [null, null, null, 1.0] caps switch_chain at 1 h for that reason. num_epochs 8 IS the ingress bound (62 chunks into 8 in-links of 1 chunk/epoch), so no horizon past it can help; the leaf broadcast (2 columns per cell over 8 leaves) also takes 8, and the 2026-11-10 dual-plane b4_nows run (solved at 19) finished in exactly 8. symmetry false: no twin-switch flow-equality rows and no switch 'inflow == max(outs)' rule. Both restrict the model (neither is exact for a MILP), and the second costs a gp.max_ per copying-switch row. chunk_symmetry_breaking (default on) orders a host's interchangeable chunks instead, which is exact. See teccl/hierarchy/milp_design.md and teccl/ncclize/multicast_output_design.md.
